spec.name: Blend v3
spec.notes: Built for calm markets: the signal works in calm regimes and gives back part of it in stressed ones. Intended to run at reduced size when volatility is high.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 11%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's claim of a 1.9 Sharpe ratio and 10% annual return is concerning given the limited research log and the presence of costs. While the strategy notes an intention to reduce size in volatile markets, this isn't explicitly implemented. The 'lucky_period' finding suggests the backtest may have benefited from a specific, non-representative time frame. Paper trading is necessary to validate the strategy's performance and robustness before deploying real capital.
